processes.name: Balancing agreement negotiation
processes.definition: Drafting, negotiating and getting approval of operational balancing agreements and contract language with connecting pipelines and shippers.
include: OBA drafts and approval status
Proposed paragraph changes to an agreement

processes.name: Commercial strategy planning
processes.definition: Planning the pipeline commercial team's strategy and annual plan, scheduling strategy meetings and evaluating storage and interconnect projects.
include: Plan and strategy meeting arrangements
Storage or interconnect project discussions
Cost estimates for new facilities

processes.name: Counterparty settlement review
processes.definition: Checking invoices, payments, penalties and ISO settlement charges or revenues against deals, and resolving price or amount discrepancies with counterparties.
include: Invoices questioned for responsibility or amount
Exchange or buyback settlement requests
Penalty charges and payments to counterparties
ISO congestion or settlement amounts checked
exclude: Volume imbalances without a billing dispute: volume-imbalance-reconciliation

processes.name: Credit exposure reporting
processes.definition: Preparing and sending the regular credit report of counterparty positions and exposure to the credit group.
include: Dated credit reports sent with attachments
Questions about counterparty exposure figures
exclude: Daily P&L or position reports: pnl-position-reporting
Lists of deals moved because of exposure: deal-book-transfer

processes.name: Curve and post ID mapping
processes.definition: Maintaining forward price curve files and the mapping of curves and post IDs to books in the risk system, including lists of new or changed post IDs.
include: Curve mapping files and their status
Lists of post IDs for a region or month
Central or regional curve file updates

processes.name: Deal book transfer
processes.definition: Moving trades from one risk book to another, including lists of deals to be flipped to a different book and deals moved to bankruptcy books, and checking the books after the move.
include: Lists of deals to move or flip to another book
Termination lists and deals moved to bankruptcy books
Follow-up lists of additional deals to move
exclude: Zeroing out or fixing a deal record: deal-record-correction
example_subjects: deals to be flipped to ft-us/cand-erms book right away
termination list for deals to be moved to bankruptcy book
additional deals to move to bankruptcy books - phy gas
deals to be moved to bankruptcy books (from russell's exposure report)

processes.name: Deal record correction
processes.definition: Correcting individual deal records in the deal capture and scheduling systems: zeroing out or killing deals, releasing changed deals and clearing deals that fail to bridge to downstream systems.
include: Lists of deals to kill or zero out in Sitara
Bridge errors for deals not flowing to downstream systems
Releases of deals after a change to a counterparty or contract
exclude: New deals needed for meter flow: meter-flow-deal-coverage
Moving deals to another book: deal-book-transfer
Changes to how a system works: system-enhancement-request
example_subjects: killing ena to ena deals in sitara
sitara release (re: changes in global due to consent to assignment)

processes.name: Desk coverage and on-call
processes.definition: Arranging shift, holiday and weekend on-call coverage for the trading and logistics desks, and passing on the on-call notes of what happened during the shift.
include: Shift schedules for the real-time desk
Holiday staffing for trading days
On-call rotations
Weekend on-call notes of deals and issues
example_subjects: on call notes for weekend; april 7th thru april 9th
new real time schedule for december 2001

processes.name: Expense report approval
processes.definition: Submitting, approving and tracking employee expense reports and collecting outstanding invoices to be expensed.
include: Expense document approval notices
Requests for outstanding items to expense

processes.name: Gas nomination handling
processes.definition: Receiving, confirming and scheduling daily and monthly gas nominations from customers and suppliers, and processing revised nominations and nom changes when volumes change.
include: Daily or monthly nomination sheets sent by a customer or supplier
Revised nominations and nom changes for a day or month
Requests to confirm nominated volumes at a meter or plant
exclude: Flow at a meter with no deal or contract behind it: meter-flow-deal-coverage
After-the-fact differences between scheduled and measured volumes: volume-imbalance-reconciliation
Supply cut or reduced because of maintenance or an upset: pipeline-outage-supply-cuts
example_subjects: calpine daily gas nomination and monthly (july) nomination
nom change for increased midcon gas

processes.name: Market rule change review
processes.definition: Following ISO and FERC proposals and rule changes, joining stakeholder calls and working out how changes affect trading and scheduling.
include: ISO market design proposals
ISO working group conference calls
FERC notices of proposed rules
exclude: Hourly derates and schedule fixes: realtime-schedule-checkout
example_subjects: caiso notice: market design 2002 draft proposal
ferc issues nopr on intra-day recalls of released capacity

processes.name: Meter flow deal and contract coverage
processes.definition: Finding gas that flowed at a meter without a valid deal ticket or transport contract, and getting a deal created, extended or a contract set up so the volume can be allocated and booked.
include: Meter flow with an expired or missing deal ticket
Requests to create or extend a deal ticket for a meter and month
Transport contracts needed at a meter
Replies that a deal ticket was created in Sitara
exclude: Reconciling scheduled and measured volumes with a party: volume-imbalance-reconciliation
Fixing deal records that fail to bridge or must be zeroed out: deal-record-correction
Moving deals between risk books: deal-book-transfer
example_subjects: copano line gain contract needed at meter 5310
ena 202 and hpl 216 transport contracts needed at meter 378 for march 2000

processes.name: Month-end close coordination
processes.definition: Setting and revising the month-end close calendar for the logistics and accounting systems and coordinating the deadlines each group must meet.
include: Month-end close schedules and revisions
Close deadlines for a scheduling system

processes.name: Performance review
processes.definition: Running the mid-year and year-end performance review cycle: scheduling review meetings and collecting employees' accomplishment lists.
include: PRC meeting scheduling
Requests for year-end accomplishments

processes.name: Pipeline capacity marketing
processes.definition: Posting and marketing available firm pipeline capacity to shippers and handling capacity release transactions, including fixing problems with the capacity postings.
include: Available firm capacity offers on Transwestern
Capacity release transactions between shippers
Errors on the unsubscribed capacity posting
exclude: Balancing agreements with connecting parties: balancing-agreement-negotiation

processes.name: Pipeline outage and supply cut handling
processes.definition: Handling notices of pipeline maintenance, pigging, plant upsets, force majeure and supply cuts: identifying affected meters and customers, notifying them and rearranging supply.
include: Planned maintenance or pigging affecting meters
Plant upsets and force majeure notices
Supply cuts on a pipeline for specific days
Letters to producers about affected meters
exclude: Power transmission derates and hourly cuts: realtime-schedule-checkout

processes.name: P&L and position reporting
processes.definition: Producing, checking and explaining the daily profit and loss, mark-to-market and position reports for trading books and desks.
include: Daily P&L or mark-to-market files and questions on them
Daily position reports for a desk or counterparty
Desk summary reports

processes.name: Real-time power schedule checkout
processes.definition: Confirming and correcting hourly power schedules, imports, ancillary service trades and positions with the ISO and counterparties, and responding to transmission derates and cuts.
include: Corrections to hourly imports or schedules at a delivery point
Short or long positions for the next day
Transmission derate notices for specific hours
Cut procedures and inter-SC trades
exclude: ISO market design proposals and stakeholder calls: market-rule-change-review
Settlement amounts from the ISO: counterparty-settlement-review
example_subjects: derate of pdci for 2/6/02 he23 &24 and 2-7-02 he01-08

processes.name: Contact and counterparty reference updates
processes.definition: Collecting and distributing staff and counterparty contact lists and updating counterparty identifiers such as scheduling coordinator IDs and DUNS numbers.
include: Requests for phone numbers for a contact list
Counterparty contact lists
Notices that a counterparty ID or DUNS number is changing
example_subjects: announcement: allegheny energy supply scid changing
info for updated contact list please

processes.name: System issue and enhancement requests
processes.definition: Reporting problems with trading, scheduling and position tools, requesting enhancements, tracking them and taking part in requirements or test sessions.
include: Enhancement tracking lists for a system
Reports of tool problems or issues
Requirements or use case meetings for a system
Demonstrations of a new position tool
exclude: Individual deals failing to bridge: deal-record-correction
example_subjects: unify enhancement tracking list for ena upstream
rescheduling of usecase analysis for enom mtg

processes.name: Time and activity reporting
processes.definition: Submitting time reports by the deadline and completing the periodic hours and activity surveys used for cost allocation.
include: Reminders that time reports are due
Holiday or absence entries for a time report
Monthly hours or activity surveys

processes.name: Trading book and product set-up
processes.definition: Requesting and setting up new trading books, portfolios and online trading products in the risk and trading systems so new business can be booked.
include: Book requests and new book requests
Lists of new books to be created
Set-up of a new online trading product
exclude: Moving existing deals between books: deal-book-transfer
Curve or post ID mappings for books: curve-postid-mapping

processes.name: User access set-up
processes.definition: Requesting, approving, changing and removing user accounts and system access for staff, including new employees and traders who must be set up to trade.
include: Access request submissions and requests for more information
Disabling or changing accounts and roles
Confirming traders are set up in a trading tool
New employee set-up
exclude: Requests to change how a tool works: system-enhancement-request

processes.name: Volume and imbalance reconciliation
processes.definition: Reconciling scheduled, nominated and measured gas volumes with a customer or pipeline after flow, and resolving the resulting imbalances, measurement questions and volume statements.
include: Monthly volume comparisons with a customer such as HL&P
Contract or pipeline imbalance updates
Requests for daily volume statements to settle an imbalance
Measurement or unaccounted-for gas questions
exclude: Upcoming nominations or nom changes: gas-nomination-handling
Missing deal or contract for meter flow: meter-flow-deal-coverage
Invoice, payment or penalty disputes: counterparty-settlement-review

processes.name: Weekly commercial reporting
processes.definition: Preparing the weekly report of pipeline deliveries and capacity use to California and the weekly bullet summary of the commercial team's activity.
include: California capacity reports for a week
Weekly bullets reports
example_subjects: california capacity report for week of 10/22-10/26
california capacity report for week of 12/17-12/21
